description: Get the effective JSON Schema for a field: the static schema overlaid with LIVE meta-derived constraints (current min/max/required/…). Check this BEFORE writing a value to learn what the reactive pipeline will accept, instead of discovering an invalid mutation only by trying it and getting a schema-violation error.

path.description: A canonical JSON Path address, e.g. "$.order.total".

name: get_effective_schema
title: Get effective schema
